aboutWhatItDoes: HealthYarn na-enyere gị aka ịjụ ajụjụ ahụike n'asụsụ Yorùbá, Igbo, ma ọ bụ Bekee ma gee ozi ahụike izugbe a kwadoro n'olu Naịjirịa. Anaghị eji AI eme ozi ọgwụgwọ ọhụrụ.
aboutWhatItDoesNot: HealthYarn anaghị achọpụta ọrịa, enye ọgwụ, ma ọ bụ gụọ ole mmadụ ga-aṅụ. N'ọnọdụ ihe mberede, gaa ụlọọgwụ ozugbo.
aboutPrivacySummary: Enweghị akaụntụ maka ọha. A na-eji olu naanị n'ime ebe nchekwa oge dị mkpirikpi ma tụfuo ya ozugbo.
